prompt: micronaut openapi multiple spec files UI frameworks support
answer:
Micronaut OpenAPI supports multiple specification files in two ways:

- **Merge additional OpenAPI files** into the generated specification using:
  ```properties
  micronaut.openapi.additional.files=openapi
  ```
  The property can point to comma-separated directories or OpenAPI YAML/JSON files. Micronaut merges their contents into the generated output.  
  Source: [Micronaut OpenAPI 5.2 docs](https://docs.micronaut.io/5.2.x/openapi/)

- **Split endpoints into separate specification files** using Micronaut versioning with `@Version` and/or endpoint grouping with `@OpenAPIGroup`.  
  Source: [Micronaut OpenAPI 5.2 docs](https://docs.micronaut.io/5.2.x/openapi/)

### UI framework support

| UI | Supports multiple spec files out of the box? |
|---|---|
| Swagger UI | Yes |
| Scalar | Yes |
| ReDoc | No; you must complete the template yourself |
| RapiDoc | No; you must complete the template yourself |
| OpenAPI Explorer | No; you must complete the template yourself |

Micronaut supports generating Swagger UI, ReDoc, OpenAPI Explorer, Scalar, and RapiDoc views, and multiple views can be enabled in one application. RapiPdf can also generate a PDF from a specification.  
Source: [Micronaut OpenAPI 5.2 docs](https://docs.micronaut.io/5.2.x/openapi/)
